vulnerable_code:
class Fleet::VehicleRoutesController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_contractor!

  def export_gpx
    # Route log resolved by tracking UUID without company boundary verification
    route_log = VehicleRouteLog.find_by!(tracking_uuid: params[:tracking_uuid])

    send_data route_log.generate_gpx_payload,
              filename: "route-#{route_log.tracking_uuid}.gpx",
              type: 'application/gpx+xml',
              disposition: 'attachment'
  end
end
diagnosis: The export_gpx action loads vehicle telemetry by tracking_uuid without restricting to current_carrier or current_contractor. External contractors can track competitors' delivery truck routes, driver stopovers, and customer drop-off locations.

corrected_code:
class Fleet::VehicleRoutesController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_contractor!

  def export_gpx
    route_log = current_contractor.company.vehicle_route_logs.find_by!(tracking_uuid: params[:tracking_uuid])

    send_data route_log.generate_gpx_payload,
              filename: "route-#{route_log.tracking_uuid}.gpx",
              type: 'application/gpx+xml',
              disposition: 'attachment'
  end
end
